implementation.summary: Scope existing twelve-loop receipt schema and durable store with explicit tenant_id and environment before producer/read integration. Preserves honest legacy unscoped rows without invented provenance, enforces zero cross-tenant leakage, rejects conflicting receipt identity, and establishes durable PostgreSQL persistence and rebuild equivalence.
implementation.current_fix: Forward migration 003 adds nullable tenant_id and environment columns to loop_receipts and twelve_loop_observations. Replaces pkey with NULLS NOT DISTINCT unique index on twelve_loop_observations (tenant_id, environment, release_id, correlation_id, loop_id). TwelveLoopStore and TwelveLoopTruthProjector enforce trusted caller scope boundaries, rejecting scope tampering and cross-tenant receipt collisions while preserving terminal-plus-next-consumer invariants.
implementation.regressions: PostgreSQL migration 002-to-003 upgrade and legacy row preservation, multi-tenant streaming and fresh process reload rebuild equivalence, cross-tenant collision rejection, out-of-order delivery with provenance fencing, and failed persistence error handling.
implementation.boundary: Scoped receipt schema, storage, and read models only; no hosted deployment, no production-data migration, no credential changes, no second store or projector.
implementation.rollback_plan: Forward migration 003 is additive. Older unscoped rows retain NULL tenant/environment. Rollback to 002 schema can be achieved by removing scoped indexes and restoring twelve_loop_observations_pkey.

verification.collection: Every listed batch was run in bounded foreground execution and terminal exit status was collected.
limitations: Parent LOOP-RECEIPT-INTEGRATION-CORRECTIVE-001 retains all genuine producer ingestion and mounted authenticated read wiring and 12-loop coverage.
No hosted deployment or live/capital-affecting write was performed; verification conducted against isolated containerized PostgreSQL 16.
